package.name: xarm1s_grasp_plugin
package.description: Minimal Gazebo Classic 11 world plugin for the thesis sim: on a ROS 2 command it creates a temporary fixed joint between the gripper link and a grasped object, so the object is carried RIGIDLY (no /set_entity_state teleport jitter). Released on command. This is the community-standard "fixed-joint attach" approach to stable grasping in Gazebo (vs unreliable friction tuning). Attaches ON COMMAND (from the grasp logic), not on auto-detected contact, so it does not depend on Gazebo's flaky contact sensing.
